collections.name: polling_architecture_reviews
collections.description: Captures the POV's core artifact: review/validation records for a polling architecture under discussion. This is the only clearly supported business entity implied by the approved requirements and current state.

open_questions: What does 'polling architecture' refer to in this context (application behavior, data ingestion, monitoring, or something else)?
How will success be measured for this POV?

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short name for the architecture review effort.

fields.name: architecture_type
fields.description: Freeform classification of what 'polling architecture' refers to, because the spec leaves this undefined.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle state of the review, e.g. proposed, in_review, validated, rejected.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Short narrative of what is being reviewed and current findings.

fields.name: vector_search_recommendation
fields.description: Records that Atlas Vector Search was suggested, without implying confirmed fit.

fields.name: fit_status
fields.description: Exploratory assessment such as suggested, evaluating, accepted, not_applicable.

fields.name: open_questions
fields.description: Question backlog specific to this review, derived from the spec's open questions.

embedding_vs_references.rationale: All substructures are tightly coupled to a single architecture review document, low-cardinality, and likely retrieved together during review workflows.

collections.name: knowledge_chunks
collections.description: Optional corpus of short text chunks used only because Atlas Vector Search is explicitly mentioned. This collection provides the minimal searchable content needed to evaluate semantic retrieval in the POV without inventing unsupported domain entities.

open_questions: Is Atlas Vector Search a firm requirement, a recommendation, or an exploratory suggestion?

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Optional reference to the architecture review this chunk supports.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Origin of the text, e.g. transcript, architecture_note, decision_log.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: External or logical identifier of the source artifact.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Chunk text used for semantic retrieval.

fields.name: embedding
fields.description: Vector embedding for Atlas Vector Search indexing.

embedding_vs_references.rationale: Chunks can scale independently and are queried separately through vector similarity search, so they should live in their own collection. Only a loose reference back to a review is needed.
